name: Delivra
description: Connect a Delivra account to explore email and SMS campaign performance, subscriber activity, engagement metrics, top domains, and poll results directly in Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Delivra to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Delivra to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://integration.delivra.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Delivra MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivra lists 13 MCP tools, including call_delivra_analytics_operation, describe_delivra_analytics_operation, get_current_delivra_account, get_delivra_campaign_analytics_summary, get_delivra_campaign_drilldowns, get_delivra_poll_analytics, get_delivra_sms_analytics, get_delivra_subscriber_performance, get_delivra_top_domains, list_delivra_accounts, list_delivra_analytics_operations, and search_delivra_campaign_tracking_stats.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Delivra?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Delivra in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Delivra requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Delivra is developed by Delivra Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
